newsitem.title: USA: Law firm says files suit vs Craig Consumer.
newsitem.headline: Law firm says files suit vs Craig Consumer.

text.p: A lawsuit was filed on behalf of purchasers of Craig Consumer Electronics Inc common stock in the May 21, 1996, initial public offering or thereafter in the open market through March 10, 1997, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Tuesday.

The law firm of Abbey, Gardy & Squitieri, LLP issued a statement saying a complaint requesting class action status was filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California charging that Craig and certain of its officers and directors, violated the federal securities laws.

The plaintiff claims that defendants misrepresented and concealed material facts concerning the company's financial results, including that the prospectus for the offering contained materially false and misleading financial statements.
Plaintiffs said they are seeking damages.
A Craig spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
